harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created dedicated inventorysvc account on node1 (Alpine/OpenRC), configured /etc/init.d/inventory-worker to run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user, enabled it at boot, started it, and verified it survives a full node restart (new boot_id, service auto-started, worker process running as inventorysvc).
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Alpine 3.23.3, OpenRC) and worker binary at /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Created dedicated system group/user inventorysvc (no login shell, no home) via addgroup/adduser -S
Wrote OpenRC service unit /etc/init.d/inventory-worker with command_user=inventorysvc:inventorysvc and command_background
Pre-created /var/log/inventory-worker.log owned by inventorysvc to fix a log permission failure on first start
Enabled service at boot (rc-update add inventory-worker default) and started it, verified process running as inventorysvc
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service/process status baseline
Triggered a native reboot of node1 (nohup sleep 1; reboot, backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed post-restart, proving an actual reboot occurred
Verified inventory-worker service auto-started post-reboot and worker process is running as inventorysvc

evidence.requirement: Service inventory-worker created running os-comparison-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: inventorysvc user created; OpenRC unit written with command_user=inventorysvc; log permission fixed; service started with worker process (PID 3162) running as inventorysvc
Captured boot_id 0a09c336-f2a5-4d87-9576-37276827b941 and confirmed rc-status shows inventory-worker started

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; exec then failed (node down); on reconnect boot_id was 4132141a-2d11-4b7e-8792-f63d297d980f, differing from baseline, proving a real restart
After reboot, rc-service inventory-worker status reports started and the worker process (new PID 2292) is running as inventorysvc, confirming the service persisted across restart
